Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
Mr. Prasanna Karnatak, learned 
counsel for the applicant.
2. Ms. Sweta Badola Dobhal, learned Brief 
Holder for the State/respondent no.1. 
3. The order passed by the Sub-Division 
Magistrate dated 31.01.2025 in a proceeding 
under Section 133 Cr.P.C. is being challenged 
in the instant petition preferred under 
Section 528 of BNSS, 2023 whereby the 
applicant is directed to remove obstacle. A 
revision was also filed against the said order 
which was also dismissed by the revisional 
court on 13.08.2026 and the same is also 
being assailed. 
4. Now a supplementary affidavit is filed 
by the applicant by contending therein that a 
“Gate” was erected by the applicant at the 
main entrance which is used to close only at 
late night for security purposes as there is 
regular threat of wild animal conflicts and 
the applicant never obstruct any person to 
use the pathway including the complainant 
and even in future he will not restrain 
anybody to use this common passage.
5. In view of the undertaking as given by 
way of supplementary affidavit dated 
20.09.2026, for an interim measure, the order 
passed by the Sub Divisional Magistrate  dated 31.01.2025 is stayed and the applicant 
is directed not to any obstacle in using the 
common passage.
6. In the meantime, the notices be issued 
to the private respondents.
7. Steps to be taken within a week. 
8. Let the respondents may file their 
counter affidavits within four weeks.
9. Two weeks time thereafter is granted to 
the applicant to file rejoinder affidavit. 
10. List in the week commencing 
23.11.2026. 
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
 23.09.2026
